finalText:
1291 mentions across 94 files. Most are plain variable names.

| Zone | Hits | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Service JS variables | 1079 | Safe to rename |
| Repo SQL column refs | 125 | Needs a DB migration first |
| Applied `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Do not edit, that is history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Do not edit, refresh overwrites it |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` + `lib/serialize.js` wire value | 6 | Frozen public field names |

The column rename would touch 12 tables plus their indexes. Every one carries a foreign key to `accounts`.

My advice: approve the JS-variable rename today. Send the column and API rename back as separate work.
